UI face for the Editions page (header, buttons, bottom index, Details text, record labels, the
sticker). SIL Open Font License 1.1 (https://openfontlicense.org).

inter-variable-ui.woff2
  Inter (Rasmus Andersson), gstatic v20, variable weight axis wght 100-900 (opsz at its default, 14)
  A Google Fonts text= subset: printable ASCII plus the punctuation the copy uses, 114 code points:
  css2?family=Inter:wght@100..900&text=<U+0020-007E, U+00A0 U+00A9 U+00B7 U+00D7 U+2013 U+2014
    U+2018 U+2019 U+201C U+201D U+2022 U+2026 U+2190-2193 U+2212 U+20AC U+2122>
  Latin-1 letters (U+00C0-00FF) are left out to lighten the first view (51 348 to 33 884 bytes); none appear in the
  copy, and any that are added later draw in the system face until the subset is re-taken with them.
  downloaded 2026-11-03 from fonts.gstatic.com/l/font?kit=... (v=v20), 33 884 bytes
  sha256 0000e816c2481bf8de6123098f5060c9ecf5444ee7719ad879d140656fc3a247
  Licence: OFL-1.1 (https://github.com/rsms/inter)

jetbrains-mono-500-page.woff2
  The project pages' mono face (hero boxes, rail, labels, captions). Loaded with the page's stylesheet
  on Open, never in the first view. JetBrains Mono (JetBrains), gstatic, weight 500.
  A Google Fonts text= subset with the same 114 code points as inter-variable-ui.woff2:
  css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@500&text=<the same list as above>
  downloaded 2026-11-03 from fonts.gstatic.com/l/font?kit=..., 18 728 bytes

  Licence: OFL-1.1 (https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono)
